AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: SHARED-FINDINGS section 2, copied not re-derived. The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation IS construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (vantom.py:33-35). Same observable today on all three clauses: (a) listener set - the only ported listeners on the hooks a starting power can reach are relics/ruined_helmet.py:23-38 and relics/unsettling_lamp.py:44-53 (modify_power_amount) and relics/vambrace.py:26-40 / relics/paels_legion.py:36-43 (modify_block_multiplicative); all four gate on `target is self.player` / `applier is self.player` / `card is not None`, and a monster's starting power is self-applied with no card, so none can fire, and sts2_rl/potions.py implements none of the four hooks; (b) HP-roll inversion - the sim applies the power before the parity Niche roll (combat.py:152-153) and the game after it, but of the constructor-applied power classes only IllusionPower reads max_hp and only inside revive() (powers.py:1581), never at apply time, and SlipperyPower 8 (Vantom.cs:64,94 - GetValueIfAscension(ToughEnemies, 9, 8), non-ascension value LAST) is a flat constant; (c) roll ordering - Vantom is a hand-rolled port with no state machine and no MonsterAi draw at all (executed: `monster_probes_b02.py seq` shows 0 draws over 40 turns), so there is no first roll to order against the power. All cited files are carried in this record's extra_sources.

AfterDeath.rationale: One of monster_state_machine boundary hole 5's eleven unclaimed C# hook overrides, handed to the content tier. Read TO THE END before deciding (the KinPriest N6 lesson): Vantom.cs:97-105 is the ENTIRE override and it is two statements - an identity guard `if (creature != base.Creature) return Task.CompletedTask;` and `NRunMusicController.Instance?.UpdateMusicParameter("vantom_progress", 5f)`. It applies no power, kills nothing, spawns nothing, reads no combat state and returns an already-completed Task. There is no mechanical behaviour for the sim to be unfaithful to, so this is a genuine out-of-scope waiver (presentation) and not a dormant gap under rule 1: the music parameter is the same class of thing as monster_state_machine's N2/N5 and exactly the same shape as KinPriest's N6 second arm (KinPriest.cs:104-107). hook_dispatch G5 is not re-verdicted here.
